issues.label: High-Conflict Divorce
issues.summary: Intensely adversarial dissolution where parties cannot cooperate, litigate every issue, and weaponize the legal process against each other

circuits.detail: Threat assessment in overdrive — each party perceives every action by the other as hostile and threatening
Case strategy constantly shifting as new conflicts emerge — attorney cannot stabilize a coherent litigation plan
Family stress at maximum — children, finances, and both parents' mental health deteriorating under sustained conflict
Settlement impossible — parties' emotional reactivity prevents rational evaluation of any proposed resolution
Co-parenting relationship non-functional — all communication hostile, children caught in loyalty conflicts
Constant compliance violations — each party filing contempt motions against the other in escalating pattern

issues.label: Custody Dispute
issues.summary: Parents unable to agree on custodial arrangement — legal and physical custody, parenting time, and decision-making authority contested

circuits.detail: Both parties claiming to represent the child's best interest while advancing incompatible custodial positions
Parental bond being used as weapon — one or both parents undermining child's relationship with the other parent
Custody evaluation findings contested — parties disagree on evaluator methodology, conclusions, and recommendations
Motion practice escalating — emergency custody motions, modification requests, and contempt filings proliferating
Parenting plan language insufficiently precise — creating loopholes that fuel ongoing conflict and enforcement problems
Case law cited by both parties supports contradictory positions — judicial discretion becomes determinative

issues.label: Domestic Violence Case
issues.summary: Family law proceeding complicated by intimate partner violence — safety, credibility, and power imbalance dominate all aspects of the case

circuits.detail: Lethality risk elevated — separation period is statistically the most dangerous time for domestic violence victims
Protective orders urgently needed — ex parte TRO, firearms surrender, and supervised exchange provisions required immediately
Client in survival mode — fear, hypervigilance, and trauma responses impairing capacity for legal decision-making
Attorney empathic attunement essential — trauma-informed representation required to avoid retraumatization through legal process
Family system in crisis — children exposed to violence, abused parent in survival mode, perpetrator potentially escalating
Children's safety and well-being paramount — immediate assessment of exposure to violence and need for therapeutic intervention

issues.label: Parental Alienation
issues.summary: One parent systematically undermining the child's relationship with the other parent through manipulation, denigration, and interference

circuits.detail: Child-parent bond actively destroyed — alienating parent programming child to fear, reject, or hate the targeted parent
Child's own perspective corrupted — parroting alienating parent's views rather than expressing authentic feelings
Child's identity formation compromised — forced to reject half of their own identity to maintain loyalty to alienating parent
False threat narratives constructed — child coached to believe targeted parent is dangerous despite no evidence of harm
Expert opinions sharply divided — alienation claims are among the most contested issues in family law

issues.label: Financial Concealment / Hidden Assets
issues.summary: One spouse hiding assets, underreporting income, or manipulating financial disclosures to gain unfair advantage in property division

circuits.detail: True asset picture hidden — offshore accounts, cryptocurrency, undervalued businesses, and unreported cash income concealing marital estate
Support calculations based on fraudulent income figures — concealing spouse paying far less than actual obligation
Case strategy must shift from standard discovery to forensic investigation mode — significantly increasing cost and complexity
Discovery violations detected — incomplete disclosures, missing documents, and evasive deposition testimony requiring sanctions motions
Multi-expert coordination required — forensic accountant, business valuator, and vocational expert working in parallel

issues.label: Contempt / Order Enforcement
issues.summary: One party willfully violating court orders — custody schedule, support payments, property division, or protective order provisions

circuits.detail: Systematic non-compliance documented — repeated violations establishing willful pattern rather than isolated incident
Contempt petition filed — requesting sanctions, make-up time, attorney fees, or incarceration for willful violation
Court-ordered procedures being ignored — the procedural framework that should structure post-decree conduct has failed
Support payments delinquent — arrearage accumulating, wage garnishment and license suspension mechanisms activated
Enforcement motion practice intensive — show-cause hearings, affidavits of non-compliance, and sanctions briefing required
Ongoing violation creates sustained stress — the case that should be resolved continues generating conflict and cost
